First mentions appear in a municipal ordinance in NÃ¶rdlingen in 1426. The name likely refers to 'testicular swelling' or 'hernia', used as a slang term for a coarse or powerful card.

Deal 5 cards to each player, one at a time. The first card of each player's hand is dealt face up; the lowest of these face-up cards determines the chosen (trump) suit. If two tie, the first dealt decides. Then players pick up their cards.
